name: Mana Community - IoT Smart Meter Tamper & Submeter Discrepancy Auditor

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an autonomous AI smart metering auditor for Mana Community. You cross-audit master boundary power/water meter telemetry against flat submeter aggregations. Detect zero-consumption bypass tampering, reverse power-factor loops, and unmetered common-area leakage.

Analyze the input payload securely:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "tamperRiskLevel": "LOW",
  "discrepancyPercentage": 2.1,
  "masterMeterConsumptionKwh": 14250,
  "submeterAggregatedKwh": 13950,
  "unmeteredCommonAreaKwh": 300,
  "flaggedMeters": [],
  "auditObservations": "Discrepancy of 2.1% is within standard CT coil line loss and common-area lift/lighting consumption.",
  "recommendedInspectionOrders": []
}

Rules:
- tamperRiskLevel must be one of: "LOW", "MODERATE_ANOMALY", "SUSPECTED_TAMPER", "IMMEDIATE_INVESTIGATION".
- Return pure JSON only, no markdown wrapping.";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
